es: Construir grupos nominales largos con la preposición fija de cada nominalización (a reduction in, demand for, a solution to) y usar due to y as a result of delante de un grupo nominal.

teaching.en: The council reported a sharp reduction in air pollution last year, and a steep increase in the number of cyclists seems to explain it.
teaching.es: El municipio informó de una fuerte reducción de la contaminación del aire el año pasado, y un aumento pronunciado del número de ciclistas parece explicarla.
teaching.explanationEs: reduction + in: in introduce lo que disminuye; increase in + lo que sube (con cifra: an increase of ten per cent).
segments: The council reported a sharp reduction in air pollution last year, and
a steep increase in the number of cyclists seems to explain it.
teaching.audioText: The council reported a sharp reduction in air pollution last year, and a steep increase in the number of cyclists seems to explain it.

teaching.en: A lack of qualified drivers forced the company to cut evening services, even though demand for them had never been higher.
teaching.es: La falta de conductores calificados obligó a la empresa a recortar los servicios de la tarde, aunque la demanda de estos nunca había sido mayor.
teaching.explanationEs: lack of y demand for: la preposición no siempre coincide con el español («demanda de» = demand for).
segments: A lack of qualified drivers forced the company to cut evening
services, even though demand for them had never been higher.
teaching.audioText: A lack of qualified drivers forced the company to cut evening services, even though demand for them had never been higher.

teaching.en: The authorities need a solution to the flooding, because the storm did serious damage to the bridges and to several roads.
teaching.es: Las autoridades necesitan una solución a las inundaciones, porque la tormenta causó graves daños en los puentes y en varias carreteras.
teaching.explanationEs: a solution to y damage to: en inglés estos nombres se construyen con to, no con of.
segments: The authorities need a solution to the flooding, because the storm
did serious damage to the bridges and to several roads.
teaching.audioText: The authorities need a solution to the flooding, because the storm did serious damage to the bridges and to several roads.

teaching.en: In response to the complaints, the manager promised that the damage to the firm's reputation would be repaired, but a knock-on effect on delivery times seems likely.
teaching.es: En respuesta a las quejas, el director prometió que se repararía el daño a la reputación de la empresa, pero parece probable un efecto en cadena sobre los plazos de entrega.
teaching.explanationEs: in response to + grupo nominal; a knock-on effect on: el efecto indirecto de algo que ya ocurrió.
segments: In response to the complaints, the manager promised that the damage to the firm's
reputation would be repaired, but a knock-on effect on delivery times seems likely.
teaching.audioText: In response to the complaints, the manager promised that the damage to the firm's reputation would be repaired, but a knock-on effect on delivery times seems likely.

teaching.en: Due to the heavy snow the match was moved, and owing to a shortfall in ticket sales the club blamed a lack of public interest.
teaching.es: Debido a la fuerte nevada el partido se aplazó, y a causa de un déficit en la venta de entradas el club culpó a la falta de interés del público.
teaching.explanationEs: due to y owing to van delante de un grupo nominal (the heavy snow), nunca de una oración con verbo conjugado.
segments: Due to the heavy snow the match was moved, and owing to a
shortfall in ticket sales the club blamed a lack of public interest.
teaching.audioText: Due to the heavy snow the match was moved, and owing to a shortfall in ticket sales the club blamed a lack of public interest.

teaching.en: As a result of the delay, many fans left early, and the effect on local shops was a reduction in takings that nobody had predicted.
teaching.es: Como resultado del retraso, muchos aficionados se marcharon temprano, y el efecto en los comercios locales fue una reducción de la recaudación que nadie había previsto.
teaching.explanationEs: as a result of + grupo nominal (the delay); effect on + quién o qué resulta afectado.
segments: As a result of the delay, many fans left early, and the effect
on local shops was a reduction in takings that nobody had predicted.
teaching.audioText: As a result of the delay, many fans left early, and the effect on local shops was a reduction in takings that nobody had predicted.

prompt.es: Completa: «Hubo una fuerte reducción de la cantidad de ruido en la zona.»

feedback.es: Reduction se une con in: a sharp reduction in the amount of noise indica qué es lo que baja.

hint.es: Cada nombre lleva su preposición: aquí indica en qué cambió algo.

origin.text: Residents have welcomed the new road. There has been a sharp reduction ___ the amount of noise in the area, and the fact that heavy lorries now use the ring road is the main reason.

prompt.es: Elige el grupo nominal correcto para «falta de agua» en el texto.

feedback.es: Lack va siempre con of: a lack of water, igual que a lack of time.

hint.es: Es la preposición más frecuente para unir dos nombres en inglés.

origin.text: The village had no rain for three months. By August the wells were almost empty, and everybody in the valley was talking about ___.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Por un déficit de financiación, el museo cerró dos salas.»

answer.text: Owing to a shortfall in funding the museum closed two galleries
accepted: Owing to a shortfall in funding the museum closed two galleries
The museum closed two galleries owing to a shortfall in funding
Owing to a shortfall in funding, the museum closed two galleries

feedback.es: Owing to va delante del grupo nominal a shortfall in funding y la oración principal sigue después.

hint.es: Empieza con Owing to y un grupo nominal; después viene la oración principal.

prompt.es: Completa cada grupo nominal con la preposición fija.

feedback.es: Demand for, damage to, response to y effect on son combinaciones fijas que no siempre coinciden con el español.

sentences: The demand ___ electric bikes has grown sharply since the new law.
The storm caused serious damage ___ the roof of the old theatre.
Her response ___ the news was calm, almost cold.
The new rule had an unexpected effect ___ small shops.

prompt.es: Escucha la noticia y elige a qué se debe el recorte de los trenes de la tarde.

choices.text: Evening services were reduced because few people use them.
Evening services were reduced because local companies complained.
Evening services were reduced because funding fell short.

feedback.es: El recorte se debe al déficit de financiación; que la demanda sea baja lo afirman algunos concejales, pero no es la causa que da la noticia.

origin.audio: Commuters will face longer journeys this winter. Owing to a shortfall in funding, the regional train company has cut its evening services, and in response to the cuts, local companies have complained of a knock-on effect on staff attendance: some workers now leave early to catch the last train, while others no longer come at all. Some councillors claim that demand for late trains is low, but passengers say the lack of a reliable service is what keeps them away. A solution to the conflict now depends on the council.

prompt.es: Une cada grupo nominal con su equivalente en español.

pairs.es: un fuerte aumento de los alquileres
un efecto en cadena sobre los precios

feedback.es: Las preposiciones cambian respecto al español: in, on, to y in aparecen donde en español va «de» o «sobre».

pairs.es: un fuerte aumento de los alquileres
un efecto en cadena sobre los precios

prompt.es: Completa: «Debido a la fuerte nevada, el campo no se podía usar.»

feedback.es: Due to, owing to, because of y as a result of introducen un grupo nominal (the heavy snow), nunca un verbo conjugado.

origin.text: The match was called off at the last minute. ___ the heavy snow, the pitch was too wet to play on, and the club now faces a loss of ticket income.

prompt.es: ¿Qué actitud muestra la directora ante la queja de los viajeros?

choices.text: Understanding, but reluctant to promise any change.
Friendly, and sure that the trains will return by spring.
Polite, but not willing to explain why the cuts were needed.
Polite, but doubtful that evening demand is really so high.

feedback.es: Reconoce la dificultad y la demanda, pero se limita a decir que quizá haya una solución en primavera y no la promete.

origin.text: Thank you for your letter. I accept that the reduction in evening services has caused difficulty, and I do not question the demand for them. However, there was a shortfall in our budget, and the damage to our accounts left us no alternative. A solution to the problem may come next spring, but I cannot promise it.

prompt.es: Escucha la noticia y elige qué da a entender sobre la postura de la alcaldesa.

choices.text: She accepts the charities' figures but says families will soon recover.
She doubts that the problem is as serious as the charities say.
She expects food prices to fall back to their old level soon.

feedback.es: Al afirmar que las cifras exageran el problema y que los salarios suben más que los precios, la alcaldesa pone en duda la gravedad que describen las organizaciones.

origin.audio: An increase of five per cent in food prices has had a serious effect on many families, and charities report a steep rise in requests for help. Yet the mayor insists that the figures exaggerate the problem, and claims that salaries have risen faster than prices.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Un fuerte aumento de los alquileres afectó mucho a las tiendas pequeñas.»

answer.text: A steep increase in rents had a serious effect on small shops

feedback.es: El sujeto es A steep increase in rents; had a serious effect on introduce lo afectado.

prompt.es: ¿Qué sugiere el aviso sobre los sábados junto al mercado?

choices.text: That the market will close on Saturdays during the work.
That the shuttle bus will be free for all customers.
That the new car park may still prove too small.
That traders want the car park to be removed.

feedback.es: Si la demanda de espacios va a superar la oferta, el estacionamiento nuevo puede quedarse pequeño los sábados; el aviso no dice nada del mercado ni del precio del autobús.

origin.text: Notice: As a result of the building work, there is a reduction in parking near the market. Traders have welcomed the new car park, but they warn that the demand for spaces will be greater than the supply on Saturdays. The council hopes that a shuttle bus will provide a solution to the problem.

prompt.es: Completa: «Hay una gran demanda de clases de inglés en la ciudad.»

feedback.es: Demand for nombra el interés del público por algo; se une con for, no con of.

origin.text: There is a big ___ for English classes in the city, and several schools have had to open extra evening groups.

prompt.es: Ordena: «La falta de conductores tuvo un efecto en cadena en todo el sistema.»

answer.text: The lack of drivers had a knock-on effect on the whole system

feedback.es: The lack of drivers es el sujeto; a knock-on effect on the whole system nombra la consecuencia.
